To be rigorous, run the isolation probe after finalizing t10. Similarly c3's t11: tail_exact false at non-multiples but that's because all values wrong (all_exact false even at 256, a multiple of 256 with tail_exact true — the tail comparison for 256 is trivially empty... actually tail_exact true for 256/131072 multiples, false for non-multiples). The right isolation: compare out to kernel's own kmap per position. Do that in one probe covering both c2 and c3 aspects.
